_doc: Ratings and reviews, shown on the house page. Live from the listing, never curated by hand. rating and count: a snapshot (null = use house-page.json's rating). source: platform name. url: the listing's reviews page. quotes: the listing's latest reviews as they are, newest first, [{name, date: YYYY-MM, text, lang}], at most 3 shown. updated: YYYY-MM-DD the values were last read from the listing, or null.
